description: Find what TravelCharika has a page for, by name: places, countries, regions, kinds of place ("beaches"), trips, departure cities, comparisons, months and holidays. Matches as the site's own search box does: accents ignored, a name a place is also known by ("Bombay"), one letter off ("Marrakesh"), and a month among the words ("bali in may") gives that month's page. Returns each match's kind, name, the id the other tools take, and its page. Call it first whenever you have a name rather than an id; nothing matching gets the nearest names instead.

query.description: What to look for: a place, country, region, kind of place, city to fly from, or a phrase such as "bali in may" or "beaches december".

name: search_places
